This confirms the mechanism clearly: Go's `embed` package embeds the built frontend assets (`dist/*`) directly into the server binary, and Echo's static-file/SPA-fallback middleware serves them.

q27. Go `embed` directive (`//go:embed dist/*`) bundles the built React app into the Go binary, served via Echo static + SPA-fallback middleware; wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (lines 20-21, 41-61).
